%.name: remainder
%.plain: a % b is the remainder a - b * (a / b), with the sign of a (-7 % 2 = -1); b = 0 gives NaN.

- (unary).name: negation
- (unary).plain: - a is the negation of a.

♯.name: pitch transpose
♯.plain: a ♯ b moves MIDI note a by b semitones; a result outside 0 through 127 gives NaN.

⇈.name: pitch octave up
⇈.plain: a ⇈ raises MIDI note a by 12 semitones; a result above 127 gives NaN.

⇊.name: pitch octave down
⇊.plain: a ⇊ lowers MIDI note a by 12 semitones; a result below 0 gives NaN.

⟷.name: pitch interval
⟷.plain: a ⟷ b is the signed number of semitones from note a to note b.

⇅.name: pitch invert
⇅.plain: a ⇅ b reflects every pitch in melody a around MIDI note b and keeps durations; an out of range pitch gives NaN.

⟲.name: pitch retrograde
⟲.plain: a ⟲ reverses the order of melody a, keeping each note with its duration.

♬.name: pitch scale step
♬.plain: a ♬ is the next higher note in C major; no higher MIDI note gives NaN.

△.name: pitch major triad
△.plain: a △ builds a three note major triad at MIDI note a with intervals 0, 4, 7 and one beat each; an out of range pitch gives NaN.

▽.name: pitch minor triad
▽.plain: a ▽ builds a three note minor triad at MIDI note a with intervals 0, 3, 7 and one beat each; an out of range pitch gives NaN.

⥁.name: pitch repeat
⥁.plain: a ⥁ b repeats melody a b times for b from 0 through 16; other counts give NaN.

⋈.name: pitch concat
⋈.plain: a ⋈ b plays melody a followed by melody b.

≎.name: pitch melody equal
≎.plain: a ≎ b is true when melodies a and b have the same pitches and beat durations.

≐.name: pitch note equal
≐.plain: a ≐ b is true when the two MIDI notes have the same pitch.
